build_hornet_large_classifier: build an ImageClassifier with a HorNet large backbone and LinearClsHead for 1000 classes
configure_hornet_backbone: configure a HorNet large backbone with 0.2 drop path rate and 1536 input channels
setup_label_smoothing_loss: setup a LabelSmoothLoss with 0.1 smoothing value in original mode for classification
configure_mixup_cutmix_augments: configure Mixup and CutMix data augmentation with alpha 0.8 and 1.0 respectively
initialize_model_weights: initialize model weights using TruncNormal for Linear layers and Constant for LayerNorm and LayerScale
